name: Sertraline
summary: A well-studied SSRI often considered first-line. Generally well-tolerated with the most pregnancy and breastfeeding safety data. Good for anxiety.

name: Escitalopram
summary: An SSRI known for good tolerability and very few drug interactions. Effective for both depression and anxiety with a clean side-effect profile.

name: Fluoxetine
summary: The longest-acting SSRI, making it easiest to stop. First-line for children and adolescents. Energizing and weight-neutral, but inhibits CYP2D6.

name: Citalopram
summary: An SSRI similar to escitalopram with few drug interactions. Note: doses limited to 20 mg/day in adults over 60 due to heart rhythm concerns.

name: Fluvoxamine
summary: An SSRI commonly used for OCD. More sedating than other SSRIs. A potent CYP1A2 and CYP2C19 inhibitor, causing many drug interactions.

name: Paroxetine
summary: An SSRI that is mildly sedating but has highest sexual side effects, weight gain, and discontinuation symptoms. Avoid in pregnancy and pediatrics.

name: Bupropion
summary: An atypical antidepressant that is energizing, weight-neutral, and has no sexual side effects. Not helpful for anxiety or pain. Good for smoking cessation.

name: Mirtazapine
summary: A sedating antidepressant that helps with sleep and appetite. Good for patients who need to gain weight. Causes the most weight gain. Few drug interactions.

name: Duloxetine
summary: An SNRI with FDA approval for several pain conditions. Good choice when depression co-occurs with chronic pain. Inhibits CYP2D6.

name: Venlafaxine
summary: An SNRI effective for depression, anxiety, and pain. Can raise blood pressure at higher doses. Difficult to discontinue. Few drug interactions.

name: Vortioxetine
summary: A newer serotonin modulator with low sexual side effects and possible cognitive benefits. Brand-only, so very expensive. Can cause significant nausea.

name: Vilazodone
summary: A newer serotonin modulator with lower sexual side effects. Must be taken with food. Can cause significant nausea and diarrhea. Generic now available.

name: Desvenlafaxine
summary: An SNRI (active metabolite of venlafaxine) with very few drug interactions. Similar efficacy but also similar discontinuation concerns as venlafaxine.

name: Trazodone
summary: Primarily used at low doses as a sleep aid alongside another antidepressant. At full antidepressant doses, sedation and orthostasis limit use. Rare priapism risk.

name: Nortriptyline
summary: A tricyclic antidepressant useful for pain and sometimes used when newer agents fail. Requires blood level monitoring. Anticholinergic effects and dangerous in overdose.

name: Levomilnacipran
summary: An SNRI with a focus on norepinephrine. May help with fatigue and motivation. Can cause urinary hesitancy. Few drug interactions but limited data overall.
